Question:
I manage a team buying a USD 12,000 vendor service that processes company data. What procurement approvals are required, and which Operations risk review applies before the vendor gets that data?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: FIN-001 — Expense, Procurement, and Reimbursement Policy ===

[Section: Expense Categories]
Chunk ID: 22e6e0ed-a681-4701-97d1-c1be7d69b0c0
Score: 0.7026
Content:
Expense Categories

| Category | Standard Limit | Approval Required |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Meals during business travel | USD 85 per day | Manager approval above limit |
| Customer-facing meals | USD 125 per attendee | Manager approval and attendee list |
| Office supplies | USD 300 per purchase | Manager approval above limit |
| Software subscription trial | USD 500 annualized value | IT review and manager approval |
| Conference registration | USD 1,500 per event | Manager approval before purchase |

Alcohol is not reimbursable unless it is part of a customer-facing meal approved by a manager before the event. Gift cards, personal devices, fines, commuting costs, and family travel are not reimbursable.

[Section: Procurement Thresholds]
Chunk ID: d19f25a2-9f43-402c-97f1-469af8113502
Score: 0.8690
Content:
Procurement Thresholds

Purchases below USD 2,500 may be approved by the employee's manager if the purchase is within the team's approved budget. Purchases from USD 2,500 to USD 10,000 require Finance review before a purchase order is issued.

Purchases above USD 10,000 require Finance review, Legal review if a contract is involved, and department leader approval. Vendors that will process company data must complete the vendor security review before contract signature, even when the spend is below USD 10,000.

[Section: Policy Status]
Chunk ID: 83a57bc9-ac5f-411e-9684-7d80d72edf1f
Score: 0.5253
Content:
Policy Status

This policy is effective February 1, 2026 and replaces the 2025 informal spend guidance. If an older team wiki or email thread lists a different limit, this policy controls unless Finance publishes a newer version.

Employees should submit expenses within 30 calendar days of the transaction date. Expenses submitted after 60 calendar days require manager approval and a Finance Operations exception note.

=== Document: OPS-001 — Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy ===

[Section: Overlap With Other Policies]
Chunk ID: 6e54582d-2f82-4e3b-a832-1117ce09a2e1
Score: 0.8248
Content:
Overlap With Other Policies

Expense reimbursement follows Finance policy. Contract signature follows Legal policy. Device configuration and data security follow IT security policy. When policies overlap, the stricter approval path applies.

[Section: Vendor Onboarding]
Chunk ID: c83e3811-1cf5-4479-899f-fd76bac98f5a
Score: 0.8230
Content:
Vendor Onboarding

New vendors require a vendor intake request before work begins. The requester must provide vendor legal name, business purpose, expected start date, estimated annual spend, data access level, and contract owner.

| Vendor Risk | Example | Required Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low | Office supplies, training materials | Operations |
| Moderate | Contractor with project files | Operations and Legal |
| High | Vendor processing company or customer data | Operations, Legal, IT Admin |
| Financial | Vendor paid through invoice or purchase order | Operations and Finance |

Vendors may not receive company data, customer data, credentials, or building access until required reviews are complete.

[Section: Policy Scope]
Chunk ID: 5feea154-dae9-493a-b80d-a17187b6ab2b
Score: 0.6509
Content:
Policy Scope

This policy covers vendor onboarding, business travel booking, equipment requests, shipping, and operations exceptions. It applies to employees, managers, HR Admins, and IT Admins who request operational support.

Finance controls reimbursement and procurement thresholds. Legal controls contract review. IT controls device security. This Operations policy explains process ownership and routing.

[Section: Exceptions]
Chunk ID: a631c612-3ff0-415b-9908-3f84c7063453
Score: 0.5620
Content:
Exceptions

Operations may approve exceptions for accessibility, business continuity, safety, or customer-critical travel. Repeated exceptions should be converted into a budget request, vendor onboarding request, or role-specific equipment standard.

=== Document: ENG-001 — Deployment, On-Call, and API Standards Handbook ===

[Section: Deployment Approval]
Chunk ID: d0cab3f6-9771-40cf-9a66-78a470bb69f7
Score: 0.5076
Content:
Deployment Approval

| Change Type | Required Review | Required Approver |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation-only release | Peer review | Team lead |
| Low-risk application change | Peer review and automated tests | Team lead |
| Database migration | Peer review, rollback plan, staging proof | Engineering Manager |
| Security-sensitive change | Peer review, IT Admin review | Engineering Manager |
| Emergency hotfix | Incident commander review | Engineering Manager on call |

All production changes must include a rollback plan. A rollback plan that says "revert if needed" is not sufficient; it must name the specific revert, migration rollback, feature flag, or mitigation.

=== Document: IT-001 — Acceptable Use Policy ===

[Section: Approved Software]
Chunk ID: e6e54af9-8787-4c13-b6fc-818ca5577795
Score: 0.5027
Content:
Approved Software

Employees should use company-approved software for messaging, file storage, source control, project tracking, and customer collaboration. Unapproved software that stores company data must not be used without IT review.

=== Document: UPLOAD-E03218D0 — Phase 40 Upload Verification 20260627161542 ===

[Section: Page 1]
Chunk ID: 220474ef-3a31-49b3-b775-d07a75e08ebc
Score: 0.5026
Content:
Page 1

Phase 40 upload verification: vendors need Operations review before starting work. This uploaded document is scoped to the Operations department and Employee role.
